6// Distinct expression trees make mixing ordered and commutative arithmetic a type error.
7[JsonPolymorphic(TypeDiscriminatorPropertyName = "kind")]
8[JsonDerivedType(typeof(PatchLiteral), "literal")]
9[JsonDerivedType(typeof(PatchThen), "then")]
10[JsonDerivedType(typeof(PatchInverse), "inverse")]
11public abstract record PatchExpression;
12public sealed record PatchLiteral(GraphPatch Patch) : PatchExpression;
13public sealed record PatchThen(PatchExpression First, PatchExpression Next) : PatchExpression;
14public sealed record PatchInverse(PatchExpression Patch) : PatchExpression;
15[JsonPolymorphic(TypeDiscriminatorPropertyName = "kind")]
16[JsonDerivedType(typeof(DeltaLiteral), "literal")]

18[JsonDerivedType(typeof(DeltaSubtract), "subtract")]
19[JsonDerivedType(typeof(DeltaNegate), "negate")]
20public abstract record DeltaExpression;

22public sealed record DeltaAdd(DeltaExpression Left, DeltaExpression Right) : DeltaExpression;
23public sealed record DeltaSubtract(DeltaExpression Left, DeltaExpression Right) : DeltaExpression;
24public sealed record DeltaNegate(DeltaExpression Delta) : DeltaExpression;
